# Spoken or written?

Much material sold as “Cantonese” is really Standard Written Chinese read aloud. Can you tell which sentences sound like natural spoken Cantonese? Answers and a full reference table are at the bottom.

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

**1.** 我們走吧。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**2.** 呢本係我嘅書。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**3.** 我唔知。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**4.** 這是我的書。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**5.** 他們很好。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**6.** 佢哋好好。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**7.** 我吃了飯。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**8.** 佢睇電視。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**9.** 這個多少錢？ — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**10.** 點解？ — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**11.** 佢係學生。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**12.** 佢畀咗一本書我。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**13.** 我沒有錢。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**14.** 我不知道。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**15.** 他給了我一本書。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**16.** 他看電視。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**17.** 我唔識講廣東話。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**18.** 你要乜嘢呀？ — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**19.** 我冇錢。 — spoken ☐ written ☐  
**20.** 現在幾點？ — spoken ☐ written ☐

<details>
<summary><strong>Answers</strong></summary>

1. **written** — Let's go. (我們 → 我哋, 吧 → 啦)
2. **spoken** — This is my book. (這 → 呢 + classifier, 是 → 係, 的 → 嘅)
3. **spoken** — I don't know. (不 → 唔; 知道 is usually shortened to 知)
4. **written** — This is my book. (這 → 呢 + classifier, 是 → 係, 的 → 嘅)
5. **written** — They're very nice. (他們 → 佢哋, 很 → 好)
6. **spoken** — They're very nice. (他們 → 佢哋, 很 → 好)
7. **written** — I've eaten. (吃 → 食, 了 → 咗)
8. **spoken** — He's watching TV. (看 → 睇)
9. **written** — How much is this? (這 → 呢, 多少 → 幾多)
10. **spoken** — Why? (為甚麼 → 點解)
11. **spoken** — He's a student. (他 → 佢, 是 → 係)
12. **spoken** — He gave me a book. (給 → 畀 (thing before person), 了 → 咗)
13. **written** — I don't have any money. (沒有 → 冇)
14. **written** — I don't know. (不 → 唔; 知道 is usually shortened to 知)
15. **written** — He gave me a book. (給 → 畀 (thing before person), 了 → 咗)
16. **written** — He's watching TV. (看 → 睇)
17. **spoken** — I can't speak Cantonese. (不會說 → 唔識講)
18. **spoken** — What would you like? (甚麼 → 乜嘢)
19. **spoken** — I don't have any money. (沒有 → 冇)
20. **written** — What time is it now? (現在 → 而家)

</details>

## Reference: written → spoken

| Written Chinese | Spoken Cantonese | Jyutping | Yale | English | What changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 他是學生。 | **佢係學生。** | keoi5 hai6 hok6 saang1. | kéuih haih hohk sāang. | He's a student. | 他 → 佢, 是 → 係 |
| 我不知道。 | **我唔知。** | ngo5 m4 zi1. | ngóh m̀h jī. | I don't know. | 不 → 唔; 知道 is usually shortened to 知 |
| 我沒有錢。 | **我冇錢。** | ngo5 mou5 cin2. | ngóh móuh chín. | I don't have any money. | 沒有 → 冇 |
| 你在哪裏？ | **你喺邊度呀？** | nei5 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3? | néih hái bīn douh a? | Where are you? | 在 → 喺, 哪裏 → 邊度 |
| 這個多少錢？ | **呢個幾多錢呀？** | ni1 go3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3? | nī go géi dō chín a? | How much is this? | 這 → 呢, 多少 → 幾多 |
| 我吃了飯。 | **我食咗飯。** | ngo5 sik6 zo2 faan6. | ngóh sihk jó faahn. | I've eaten. | 吃 → 食, 了 → 咗 |
| 他們很好。 | **佢哋好好。** | keoi5 dei6 hou2 hou2. | kéuih deih hóu hóu. | They're very nice. | 他們 → 佢哋, 很 → 好 |
| 這是我的書。 | **呢本係我嘅書。** | ni1 bun2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 syu1. | nī bún haih ngóh ge syū. | This is my book. | 這 → 呢 + classifier, 是 → 係, 的 → 嘅 |
| 你要甚麼？ | **你要乜嘢呀？** | nei5 jiu3 mat1 je5 aa3? | néih yiu māt yéh a? | What would you like? | 甚麼 → 乜嘢 |
| 我正在工作。 | **我做緊嘢。** | ngo5 zou6 gan2 je5. | ngóh jouh gán yéh. | I'm working. | 正在 + verb → verb + 緊; 工作 → 做嘢 |
| 他給了我一本書。 | **佢畀咗一本書我。** | keoi5 bei2 zo2 jat1 bun2 syu1 ngo5. | kéuih béi jó yāt bún syū ngóh. | He gave me a book. | 給 → 畀 (thing before person), 了 → 咗 |
| 我們走吧。 | **我哋走啦。** | ngo5 dei6 zau2 laa1. | ngóh deih jáu lā. | Let's go. | 我們 → 我哋, 吧 → 啦 |
| 為甚麼？ | **點解？** | dim2 gaai2? | dím gáai? | Why? | 為甚麼 → 點解 |
| 現在幾點？ | **而家幾點呀？** | ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3? | yìh gā géi dím a? | What time is it now? | 現在 → 而家 |
| 我不會說廣東話。 | **我唔識講廣東話。** | ngo5 m4 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2. | ngóh m̀h sīk góng gwóng dūng wá. | I can't speak Cantonese. | 不會說 → 唔識講 |
| 他比我高。 | **佢高過我。** | keoi5 gou1 gwo3 ngo5. | kéuih gōu gwo ngóh. | He's taller than me. | A 比 B 高 → A 高過 B |
| 他看電視。 | **佢睇電視。** | keoi5 tai2 din6 si6. | kéuih tái dihn sih. | He's watching TV. | 看 → 睇 |
| 我很喜歡吃點心。 | **我好鍾意食點心。** | ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 dim2 sam1. | ngóh hóu jūng yi sihk dím sām. | I really like dim sum. | 很 → 好, 喜歡 → 鍾意, 吃 → 食 |
| 你說甚麼？ | **你講乜嘢呀？** | nei5 gong2 mat1 je5 aa3? | néih góng māt yéh a? | What did you say? | 說 → 講, 甚麼 → 乜嘢 |
| 那裏有很多人。 | **嗰度有好多人。** | go2 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4. | gó douh yáuh hóu dō yàhn. | There are lots of people there. | 那裏 → 嗰度, 很 → 好 |
